# Adam R. Cagle

> Adam R. Cagle builds production AI systems and writes the brands they speak for. Founder of Agentic689, which ships production AI agents, AI enablement systems, and AI-assisted creative workflows. Co-founder and Managing Director of Agency689 for 25 years, where he ran new business, pitches, proposals, client relationships, teams, and schedules while directing creative and copy for sixty-plus brands. Based in Bend, Oregon. Ad Club and Webby honored for copy.

## Who

- Name: Adam R. Cagle
